## buddy-sbx logs

Fetch or stream logs of a sandbox or supervisor session

### Synopsis

Logs prints container output logs or supervisor session logs from the specified sandbox.

```
buddy-sbx logs <sandbox-id> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Fetch logs from a sandbox
  buddy-sbx logs my-box

  # Follow logs in real time
  buddy-sbx logs my-box -f

  # Fetch logs from a supervisor session
  buddy-sbx logs my-box --session sess-9b9ad3488cc2

  # Tail the last 50 lines with timestamps
  buddy-sbx logs my-box --tail 50 --timestamps
```

### Options

```
      --container string   Container to read logs from (agent or git-init)
  -f, --follow             Stream live log updates
  -h, --help               help for logs
  -s, --session string     Read logs from a specific supervisor session
      --tail int           Number of lines to show from the end of the logs (default 100)
  -t, --timestamps         Show timestamps
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string     Path to config file (default: ~/.buddy/config.yaml)
      --endpoint string   Buddy Gateway endpoint URL (overrides context)
      --token string      Authentication token (overrides context)
```
